why: Lint cycle 7 (docs/v3/cycles/lint-7.md, lint-7.1 to lint-7.8 P2, lint-7.9 to lint-7.12 P3). change: Core rule first. lint-7.1: `routerDefaults` stops needing a binding read before its declaration (it takes the router after `createRouter`, e.g. `defaults.bind(router)`, or reads it from `BasaltProvider`), and the template, the doc example and the playground drop the waiver; if no API change fits, the doc example carries the template's reasoned waiver line and `CORE_RULES`' JSDoc names the lazy getter as the case it waives. The rule stays at `error` for the crash v3-expr-5-keys added it for. lint-7.2: the managed set is the preset's whole rule list: doctor check 11 reports a `CORE_RULES` id set off or lowered by hand as it reports `basalt/dark-fork` (W2, W11), and `lint --stats` and the waiver ceiling count a reasoned waiver of a `CORE_RULES` id. Misses, each with an invalid fixture block or a stated limit in the rule's JSDoc: `DARK_VARIANT` reads `(group|peer|in)-[…]` (named group and peer included) holding `.dark` or the theme attribute (lint-7.3); the stylelint value lists that read a `--vx-<role>` read `--color-<role>` beside it, and `property-disallowed-list` bans declaring a `--color-*`, `--radius*` or `--font-*` name the basalt theme defines (lint-7.4); import-boundary adds `antd`, `@heroui/*` and `@nextui-org/*` to `radix`, `@reduxjs/toolkit/query` to `data-library`, `classnames` to `tailwind-merge`, `material-react-table` and `mantine-react-table` to the table engines, `reconnecting-websocket` and `partysocket` beside socket.io-client (lint-7.5); reader-loop reads `res.body?.getReader()` as it reads `res.body!.getReader()` (lint-7.6); timer-refetch reads a timer whose callback argument is an identifier or member named `refetch`, `invalidate`, `invalidateQueries` or `refetchQueries` (lint-7.7); media-query reads orientation, height, aspect ratio and the device forms in a JS query, a `navigator.userAgent` test, and `react-device-detect`'s `isMobile`/`isTablet` (lint-7.8). The P3s (lint-7.9 to lint-7.12) are each caught or stated: the surface-recipe control signal exempts the shadow only on an interactive element or a class string outside JSX, and `CARD_BORDER` reads `border-1`; an interpolated variant prefix (`` `${at}:hidden` ``); `grid-template`, `grid-auto-columns` and `grid-auto-rows` in the track list; `toDateString`, `toTimeString` and `toUTCString` in intl-format; CSS relative colour syntax in colour-literal; `location`, `navigator` and `performance` as impure globals in validate-search-pure; `@tailwind` in the at-rule list.
commits: fix: one commit per rule family in packages/basalt-ui (core rule and managed set, class, import, structure, stylelint); the two playground waiver removals, if any, as their own non-package commit.
